title: Renewable Pottery Sherds
description: Makes a Smithing Recipe for Pottery Sherds
body:
Allows you to use a smithing table to create duplicates of pottery sherds the player has already collected.
- This means a player must first normally obtain the shard they wish to make more of.

![Place a sherd, then a clay ball, then a fire sharge on the left hand side. Then you get 2 of the same sherd in output](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/871f416a311601a5a5a134b16ec6834a43d989cd.png)

For anyone interesting in the recepie reasoning, you mold the clay ball then blast it with the fire charge.
